verdict.rationale: Brex documents built-in AI agents (audit agent, review agent, Brex AI) that autonomously handle expense memos, receipt fetching, policy checks, and reimbursement filing, plus AI-driven payment drafting in Bill Pay — direct evidence of delegating tasks to an in-product AI assistant. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating these agent capabilities in practice, and more detail on user-initiated delegation workflows beyond marketing copy.
